rows.Kwic: 師云：「高高峰頂立，深深海底行。」

Override.AttributionNote: 懶石聆禪師語錄, Buddha-birthday public exchange. Lanshi Ling is the exact speaker of the stored answer: after the monk's advance, he says, 'stand on the highest peak; walk in the deepest ocean.'

rows.Kwic: 二十五日已前，虛空包不住，深深海底行；二十五日已後，大地載不起，高高峰頂立；正當二十五日，十方俱坐斷，縱橫得自由。

Override.AttributionNote: 懶石聆禪師語錄, twenty-fifth-day hall address. Lanshi Ling is the exact speaker: he places walking in the deepest sea before the day, standing on the highest peak after it, and sitting cut off in all ten directions on the day itself.
